about: Gold set for `bin/brain bench`. Every answerable question was written by reading the file named in expected_file; expected_phrase is copied from it (a list means any one of those wordings of the same fact counts) (matched case-insensitively, with markdown ** and backticks stripped and whitespace collapsed). alt_files lists other files that state the same fact in the same words -- evidence from any of them counts. router_leaf is the ONE leaf a careful model would load from CLAUDE.md's routing table (null = no row fits, so the router-only path reads CLAUDE.md alone). kind: claude = a fact already in CLAUDE.md; leaf = in a routed leaf; buried = inside a doc the router does not name; hop = the obvious file only points at the answer; refusal = not in the brain.
